name: medikiosk
description: MediKiosk — AI-powered multimodal clinical intake and patient case-taking platform

scripts.build:foundation: npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/shared-types && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/clinical-schema && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/ai && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/evidence-model && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/longitudinal && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/interview-engine && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/auth && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/i18n && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/safety-rules && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/api
scripts.build: npm run build:foundation && npm run build --workspace @medikiosk/kiosk
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:foundation && tsc -p apps/kiosk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.format: prettier --write "packages/{shared-types,clinical-schema,safety-rules,auth,i18n,ai,evidence-model,longitudinal}/src/**/*.ts" "packages/{evidence-model,longitudinal}/__tests__/**/*.ts" "services/api/src/**/*.ts" "apps/kiosk/{src/**,*.ts,*.json,index.html}" package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/{shared-types,clinical-schema,safety-rules,auth,i18n,ai,evidence-model,longitudinal}/src/**/*.ts" "packages/{evidence-model,longitudinal}/__tests__/**/*.ts" "services/api/src/**/*.ts" "apps/kiosk/{src/**,*.ts,*.json,index.html}" package.json tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
